name: Naphthenic oils (petroleum), complex dewaxed heavy; Baseoil - unspecified; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by removing straight chain paraffin hydrocarbons as a solid by treatment with an agent such as urea. It consists of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C20 through C50 and produces a finished oil having a viscosity of at least 100 SUS at 100 °F (19cSt at 40 °C). It contains relatively few normal paraffins.]
